verses.text: Ephraim is grazing [on] the wind and pursuing the east wind all the day, he multiplies lies and violence; they cut a covenant with Assyria and oil is carried to Egypt.

segments.text: Ephraim is grazing [on] the wind and pursuing the east wind all the day, he multiplies lies and violence; they cut a covenant with Assyria and oil is carried to Egypt.

verses.text: A dispute [is] unto YHWH against Judah, to visit punishment on Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds He will recompense to him.

segments.text: A dispute [is] unto YHWH against Judah, to visit punishment on Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds He will recompense to him.

verses.text: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his strength he struggled with God.

segments.text: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his strength he struggled with God.

verses.text: He struggled with the angel and prevailed; he wept and sought favor from Him; at Bethel he found Him, and there He spoke with Him,

segments.text: He struggled with the angel and prevailed; he wept and sought favor from Him; at Bethel he found Him, and there He spoke with Him,

verses.text: and YHWH, God of Hosts—YHWH [is] His memorial.

segments.text: and YHWH, God of Hosts—YHWH [is] His memorial.

verses.text: And you must return to your God; Keep love and justice, and wait for your God continually!

segments.text: And you must return to your God; Keep love and justice, and wait for your God continually!

verses.text: A Canaanite [has] scales of deceit in his hand; he loves to oppress.

segments.text: A Canaanite [has] scales of deceit in his hand; he loves to oppress.

verses.text: And Ephraim said, “Surely I have become rich. I have found wealth for myself. In all my labors they will find in me no iniquity that [is] sin.”

segments.text: And Ephraim said, “Surely I have become rich. I have found wealth for myself. In all my labors they will find in me no iniquity that [is] sin.”

verses.text: And I [am] YHWH your God, from the land of Egypt; again I will make you dwell in tents, like the days of the appointed time.

segments.text: And I [am] YHWH your God, from the land of Egypt; again I will make you dwell in tents, like the days of the appointed time.

verses.text: And I have spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and by the hand of the prophets I have given parables.

segments.text: And I have spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and by the hand of the prophets I have given parables.

verses.text: If iniquity [is] in Gilead, surely they are worthless; In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls; even their altars [are] as heaps over the furrows of the field.

segments.text: If iniquity [is] in Gilead, surely they are worthless; In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls; even their altars [are] as heaps over the furrows of the field.

verses.text: And Jacob fled to the land of Aram, and Israel worked for a wife, and for a wife he tended.

segments.text: And Jacob fled to the land of Aram, and Israel worked for a wife, and for a wife he tended.

verses.text: And by a prophet YHWH brought up Israel from Egypt, and by a prophet he was kept.

segments.text: And by a prophet YHWH brought up Israel from Egypt, and by a prophet he was kept.

verses.text: Ephraim has provoked to anger bitterly, and his bloodguilt He will leave upon him, and his reproach his Lord will make return to him.
